name: ShiMamaProtocol executePairBurn without access control
summary: ShiMamaProtocol.executePairBurn is callable by anyone and sizes its pull from a caller-supplied referenceIn, using its forcePullFromPair power on ShiMamaToken to take ShiMama out of the ShiMama/FlapTaxToken pair, sync and burn it. The attacker pulled all but 21.54 ShiMama, sold 30.78 ShiMama into the collapsed pair for its FlapTaxToken and dumped that for WBNB.
notes: Reset: ShiMamaToken.setProtocol(0x5049d103) granted the protocol the onlyProtocol forcePullFromPair power that executePairBurn uses; without it the pull reverts, so this role grant, 626 blocks after the protocol's deployment, is the latest change the exploit needed.

The pair lost 14.88M FlapTaxToken: 14.13M sold by the attacker for 52.98 WBNB and 0.74M taken as the token's transfer tax. FlapTaxToken has no DefiLlama price and the dump moved its WBNB pool by about a quarter, so the whole amount is valued at the attacker's realised rate.
